# Filters in Patch My PC Cloud

_Applies to: Patch My PC (PMPC) Cloud_

You can use _Filters_ in Patch My PC (PMPC) Cloud to find only the relevant information you need.

Filters can be found on the home pages of the following nodes of the PMPC Cloud Portal:

* App Catalog (and all sub-pages)
* Deployments
* Events

To apply a deployment filter:

{% hint style="info" %}
**Note**

Although this example uses applying a deployment filter, the process of applying and clearing filters is the same, regardless of the Cloud Portal node you are in (provided the node supports Filters).

See the [List of Patch My PC Cloud Filters](../technical-references/list-filters.md) for a list of the Filters available in each node.
{% endhint %}

1. Navigate to the **Deployments** page of the Cloud Portal to see a list of your current deployments.
2. Click the Filter button in the header of the **Deployments** page.

<figure><img src="../../.gitbook/assets/image (15).png" alt="Clicking the Filter button" width="563"><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

The Filter sidebar opens.

<figure><img src="../../.gitbook/assets/image (30).png" alt="Filter sidebar" width="563"><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

3. Configure your required filters, then click **Apply All Filters**.

<figure><img src="../../.gitbook/assets/image (64).png" alt="Clicking ‘Apply All Filters’" width="563"><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

Only the deployments matching the filter criteria are displayed.

<figure><img src="../../.gitbook/assets/image (135).png" alt="Filtered Deployments page" width="563"><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

{% hint style="info" %}
**Note**

You can click the Filter button to close the filter sidebar to see more details about the results without affecting either the Filter or the results.

If you either navigate to a different page in the Cloud Portal or click **Clear All**, any Filters are automatically cleared.
{% endhint %}

{% hint style="success" %}
**Tip**

When a Filter is applied, a green dot appears beside the Filter button.

<img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Green dot beside the Filter button" data-size="original">
{% endhint %}
